answer: The pigment register is checked at draw time, pearl lists the eligible set, and lagoon seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 39 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 39 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 35 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
